presentation_amendment.reason: Human review found that the original figure title implied different target-specific choices even though all criteria selected 50 d, and the random-strategy table displayed the first random draw rather than a varied-candidate label. Numerical estimates and decision rules were unchanged.

validation_checks: Exactly 16 designs times 2 parameters are reported.
Each cell contains n=250 paired replicates and a finite median with a 95% bootstrap interval.
Parameter-specific coverage and calibration success are present.
Local and distant starting regimes are separated.
Parameter-specific errors are reported for every selected strategy.
Paired comparisons use shared replicate identifiers and bootstrap intervals.
Production PHREEQC calculations are finite and non-penalty outputs.
Data-only single- and multi-time designs report sensitivity collinearity and numerical rank.
The independent surface-area observation restores numerical rank two.
Balanced 2x2 layout with readable labels and units.
Panels distinguish predicted local information from realised recovery.
Kinetic structural evidence is labelled as a controlled synthetic result.
